annotations.title: Ecommerce metrics (AOV, conversion rate, revenue per visitor)

description: Calculates average order value, conversion rate, revenue per visitor and orders per customer, and the sessions needed to hit a revenue target.

currency.description: ISO currency code for display, for example INR, USD or AED. Defaults to INR.

sessions.description: Optional sessions or visitors in the same period.

target_revenue.description: Optional revenue goal for the same period length.
